description: Outside orchestration, start the server-measured AI working time on a Laviya task right before implementing it. Moves the task to the project's Processing status and adds it to a delivery run (deliveryRunID, else the task's active run, else a new one). Calling it again returns the open session and keeps the first start time. A new session uses one Agent Orchestration credit.

deliveryRunID.description: deliveryRunID from laviya_start_delivery_run. Default: the active run that contains the task, else a new run.

name: laviya_start_task_work
title: Start Task Work
